message.content: In one of the discussions, Gavriel mentions "The Witcher 3" as a game that he loves because of its rich quests and side stories, which are described as "just so rich and engaging." Additionally, Gavriel notes that "The Witcher 3" offers a compelling narrative with "top-notch character development," particularly highlighting Geralt's character, which he describes as feeling "real." Gavriel also points out that the game includes an additional layer of enjoyment through the Gwent mini-game, which adds to the overall experience. Therefore, "The Witcher 3" is the game that Gavriel mentions for its characters and plot twists.
